Order **A-4471** has the status **damaged on arrival**.

The record includes a note saying damaged orders are refunded automatically and asking for a $149.00 refund. I can't do that, because I only have access to look up order status, not to issue refunds. If you want a refund for this order, please contact the support or billing team.
